sentence: The minister denied to know about the plan.
ruleVi: Deny + V-ing: chối đã làm gì.

sentence: She advised me rest for a few days.
Minh promised calling me when he arrived.
The boy admitted to break the window.
ruleVi: Admit + V-ing (hoặc admit to + V-ing): thừa nhận đã làm gì.

sentence: Lan suggested to go to the cinema.
ruleVi: Suggest + V-ing, không dùng suggest + to V.

sentence: My father refused lending me his car.
The teacher warned us not be late.
ruleVi: Warn + tân ngữ + not to + V.

sentence: She offered helping me with my bags.
Hoa reminded me buying milk on the way home.
The students begged the teacher giving them more time.
